visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in an indoor room where a woman with long black hair, wearing a grey and white horizontal striped top and grey trousers, stands with her back to the camera. She is facing a large sliding glass door that is partially open, with her arms stretched high above her head in a wide 'V' shape, seemingly enjoying the daylight. To her left is a wooden bookshelf filled with various small items and plush toys, and pink curtains hang on both sides of the window. (2) The woman shifts her pose, bringing her hands behind her neck with elbows pointed outwards, continuing her stretch while looking out at the bright, overexposed outdoor scenery. The room is well-lit by natural light coming from the window. (3) The woman suddenly turns around to face the camera, revealing she is wearing glasses and has a noticeable pregnancy. She smiles broadly, placing one hand on her belly and the other near her mouth as she laughs. (4) She begins to walk towards the camera, gesturing with her hands as if explaining her actions. Her facial expression remains joyful and animated as she engages with someone off-camera. The camera slightly pans and moves closer to her as she approaches.
